description: This file contains unit tests for the ExecHostRequestEvaluator component of the OpenClaw project, verifying request validation and evaluation logic in different security and decision scenarios.

classes.name: ExecHostRequestEvaluatorTests
classes.description: A struct that encapsulates test methods to validate the behavior of ExecHostRequestEvaluator.

methods.name: validate request rejects empty command
methods.description: Tests that an ExecHostRequest with an empty command array is considered invalid.

methods.name: evaluate requires prompt on allowlist miss without decision
methods.description: Verifies that evaluation requires user prompt when allowlist is not satisfied, and no decision has been made.

methods.name: evaluate allows allow once decision on allowlist miss
methods.description: Checks that a one-time allow decision is permitted when allowlist conditions are not fully satisfied.

methods.name: evaluate denies on explicit deny decision
methods.description: Ensures that an explicit deny decision triggers a deny response during evaluation.

methods.name: makeContext
methods.description: A helper static function to create a sample ExecApprovalEvaluation context with specified parameters for testing.
